preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(l == int(l) and r == int(r) and 1 <= l <= r <= 10**9 for l, r in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case contains two integers l and r where 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout == 'YES') == any(a > 0 and all((x // a) * a + (a if (x % a) >= (a / 2) else 0) > x for x in range(l, r + 1)) for a in range(1, r + 1)) for l, r, stdout in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]], [line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, 'YES' is printed if there exists an integer a such that for every x in [l, r], the customer buys more cans than they wanted initially. Otherwise, 'NO' is printed.
